name: finna
description: Finna.fi is the Finnish national search service for libraries, archives and museums. This CLI searches and reads records and authority data through the public read-only Finna REST API (api.finna.fi) and gets citations, exports and holdings from www.finna.fi.

commands.name: search-records
commands.summary: Keyword search over Finna's index of books, images, archive material and museum objects, with filters, sorting and paging (public Finna API)

params.name: filter
params.description: Facet filter as field:"value", e.g. format:"0/Book/", format:"0/Image/", online_boolean:"1", building:"0/Helmet/". Facet values come from get-facets or list-organisations.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order, e.g. 'relevance,id asc', 'main_date_str desc' (newest first), 'main_date_str asc', 'title,id asc', 'author,id asc', 'first_indexed desc'

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (0-100) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.name: get-record
commands.summary: Get full metadata for one record by its Finna id (public Finna API), optionally choosing which fields to return

params.name: id
params.description: Finna record id, e.g. helmet.1830976 or museovirasto.2588B7F548C8DB31DF7968B845EB1520

params.name: field
params.description: Return only this field. Examples: title, authors, subjects, summary, images, imageRights, urls, buildings, year, fullRecord. Leave empty for the default field set.

commands.name: get-facets
commands.summary: List facet values with counts (formats, organisations, languages, years, ...) for a search or for the whole index; the values can be used as search-records filters

params.name: lookfor
params.description: Search terms to scope the counts (empty = whole index)

params.name: filter
params.description: Facet filter as field:"value", e.g. online_boolean:"1"

commands.name: list-organisations
commands.summary: List the organisations (libraries, archives, museums) whose material is in Finna, with record counts, from the building facet

params.name: lookfor
params.description: Optional search terms; lists only the organisations that have matching records

commands.name: search-authorities
commands.summary: Search authority records for people and organisations (public Finna API)

params.name: filter
params.description: Facet filter as field:"value", e.g. to limit results to persons or to corporate bodies

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (0-100) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.name: get-authority
commands.summary: Get one authority record (person or organisation) by id, using an id from search-authorities (public Finna API)

params.name: id
params.description: Authority record id exactly as returned by search-authorities, e.g. melinda.(FI-ASTERI-N)000030333 or ahaa-eac.EAC_2022113969

commands.name: get-citation
commands.summary: Get ready-made citations (APA, Chicago, MLA, Harvard) for a record

commands.name: export-record
commands.summary: Export a record as a citation-manager file (RIS, BibTeX, EndNote, RefWorks, MARC ...) and return the raw text

params.name: style
params.description: Export format, e.g. RIS, BibTeX, EndNote, MARC, MARCXML (RefWorks and EndNoteWeb redirect to external services)

commands.name: get-record-tab
commands.summary: Load a record page tab as an HTML fragment, e.g. library holdings/availability or user comments
commands.verifyNote: write: dry-run preview only, not sent

notes: finna.fi's own /Search/Results and /AJAX/JSON endpoints are blocked by robots.txt or return 403, so searches go through the public read-only REST API at https://api.finna.fi/api/v1 (OpenAPI spec: https://api.finna.fi/api/v1/?openapi). The API's terms of use apply.
Record ids look like '<source>.<local id>', e.g. helmet.1830976 or museovirasto.2588B7F548C8DB31DF7968B845EB1520. The human-readable page is https://www.finna.fi/Record/{id}.

Filters use the raw facet value with quotes, e.g. format:"0/Book/" or building:"0/Helmet/". Hierarchical values have a level prefix (0/, 1/...). Use get-facets or list-organisations to find valid values.

Cover images and thumbnails are binary and are not a command. Fetch https://www.finna.fi/Cover/Show?source=Solr&id={id}&index=0&size=large (size small|medium|large), or use the paths in the 'images' field of the API record.
Adding a record to favourites (/Record/{id}/Save) and other personal features need a Finna login and are not included.
The get-authority example id was not seen in the recording. Take real ids from search-authorities.
